pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Every time you smile, my heart aches
Even knowing we were hurting each other
We kept pretending nothing was wrong
When I hold your hand
I’m afraid I’ll fall apart just like you

[Chorus]
I wish we could have dreamed together
But this is where it ends
A love that could never quite reach each other
Now it’s time to let go

[Verse 2]
I was always the one who begged you to stay
When you tried to walk away
Now I finally understand
That as much as I loved you
You loved me just the same

[Pre-Chorus]
We loved each other, but…
We know each other too well
Even if we get closer, all that waits is pain
I can’t make you cry anymore

[Chorus]
I wish we could have dreamed together
But this is where it ends
A love that could never quite reach each other
Now it’s time to let go

[Bridge]
We loved each other, but…
We know each other too well
The closer we get, the more we’re left with scars
That’s why… I can’t go on

[Final Chorus]
Why couldn’t we ever become one?
Thank you… and I’m sorry
Every moment you walked into my life
Was love… real love

[Outro]
You were my first and my last love
I loved you…
Now… goodbye
Take care…
My love…
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
